intro: Stepping Stones is an investigation launched from a weathered note posted in the rugged wilds of the Barrens. The scrawled parchment says two couriers had been making deliveries for the New Plague, and calls what befell them simple apothecary accidents. The mysterious writer urges whoever finds it to seek out a secluded mountain refuge tucked along the border of Desolace.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."

clips.title: Completion
paras: Backcountry adventurers and mercenaries alike undoubtedly make camp here. The corner of a note flapping in the breeze catches your eye and you reach for it.
